title: One-Sided Randomized Polynomial Time Is in NP
statement: Every language decidable in polynomial time by a randomized machine with one-sided error and acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members belongs to NP: membership can be certified by a witness of length bounded by a polynomial in the input length, with the input and witness accepted by a deterministic polynomial-time verifier.
